subject.why: The rope bridge and lantern are clearly depicted and recognizable.

category.why: The cliff and foliage crowd the background instead of leaving an open sky above a bottom strip.

clean.why: Free of UI, text, watermarks, and characters.

framing.why: The bridge posts and ropes are cut off on the left and right borders.

colour.why: Vibrant, saturated palette with clear contrast against the sky.

detail.why: Stylized forms without excessive micro-textures or busy surface noise.

style.why: Matches reference lighting, soft sheen, and smooth chunky volumes.

fix: Reduce the right-hand cliff scenery to keep the background mostly open sky, and scale the bridge down so its posts do not clip the side edges.
